Below is a short summary of my degrees and employments. A detailed research CV and a teaching CV are accessible through the links at the bottom of the page.

## Degrees

**2025. PhD in Scandinavian Languages,** Department of Swedish Language and Multilingualism, Stockholm University. Thesis title: Comparing theories of pre-linguistic normalization for vowel perception. Supervisors: Catrin Norrby, Niclas Abrahamsson, T Florian Jaeger.

**2018. Master of Philosophy,** Swedish as a Second Language, Stockholm University.

**2010. Master of Education,** Swedish as a Second Language, Spanish, French, Community Pedagogy, University of Gothenburg.

## Employment (a selection)

**2025 nov-ongoing. Postdoctoral fellow in Linguistics,** Department of Linguistics and Scandinavian Studies, University of Oslo. Full time, temporary position.

**2025 aug-2025 dec. Senior lecturer in Bilingualism,** Centre for Research on Bilingualism, Department of Swedish Language and Multilingualism, Stockholm University. Full time, temporary position.

**2024 nov-2025 aug. Lecturer (adjunkt) in Swedish as a Second Language,** Department of Swedish Language and Multilingualism, Stockholm University. Full time, permanent position.

**2019 jan-2024 nov. PhD student in Scandinavian Languages,** Department of Swedish Language and Multilingualism, Stockholm University. Full time, temporary position.

**2017-2019. Lecturer (adjunkt) in Swedish as a Second Language,** Department of Swedish Language and Multilingualism, Stockholm University. Full time, permanent position from February 2018. Assistant project manager of Tisus.

**2016-2017. Adjunct lecturer (adjungerad lärare) in Swedish as a Second Language,** Department of Swedish Language and Multilingualism, Stockholm University. Part time (20-40%). Test item writer for Tisus.

**2010-2017. Senior teacher of Swedish as a Second Language in municipal adult education,** SIFA Stockholms intensivsvenska för akademiker, Stockholm. Full time, permanent position, appointed Senior Teacher in 2015.
